### ST-065

**Rule schema, scopes and core selectors**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **rules by path, package, module, class, function and method**, so that **testing policies follow our architecture**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 8 | S6 | I01–I05, §14.2, §14.3 | [ST-003](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-003), [ST-037](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-037) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Rules match by path glob, package, class/function/method name patterns
- [x] Rules may declare `require`, `coverage`, `risk`, `execution`, `generate`
- [x] Rule evaluation for a symbol is a pure function with golden tests

---

### ST-066

**Deterministic precedence and conflict detection**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **predictable outcomes when rules overlap**, so that **policies can't silently weaken each other**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S7 | I10, §14.6 | [ST-065](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-065) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Precedence: specificity, then declaration order; documented
- [x] Mandatory safeguards cannot be weakened by lower-priority rules
- [x] Conflicting templates/destinations raise `ST_RULE_CONFLICT` (exit 3)

---

### ST-067

**Decorator, visibility, kind and inheritance selectors**

*As a **NestJS developer**, I want **rules like 'every `@Controller` needs integration tests'**, so that **framework conventions map to policies**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟧 Should | 3 | S7 | I06, §14.3 | [ST-065](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-065), [ST-039](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-039) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Selectors for decorator, visibility, symbol kind, implements/extends
- [x] Selectors combine with AND semantics
- [x] Covered by golden tests on the NestJS fixture

### ST-068

**Coverage, criticality and execution policies**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **rules to require test categories, coverage thresholds and always-run behavior**, so that **critical areas get stronger protection**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S7 | I07, I08, I09 | [ST-065](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-065), [ST-060](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-060) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `execution.alwaysRunOnAffected` and `execution.mode` honoured by the impact engine
- [x] Missing required test categories are reported as policy findings
- [x] Coverage thresholds are evaluated when coverage is available, otherwise reported as 'not evaluated'

### ST-069

**`rules list | validate | explain`**

*As a **developer**, I want **to inspect which rules apply to a file or symbol and why**, so that **policy decisions are transparent**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S7 | I11, I12, §14.7 | [ST-066](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-066) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `rules list` shows all rules with scope and source
- [x] `rules validate` checks schema and conflicts
- [x] `rules explain <path|symbol>` shows matched rules, precedence and effective policy
